name: Hyundai Motor Securities
verdict: KOSPI-listed Hyundai Motor Securities' largest shareholder is the Hyundai Motor side (Hyundai Motor plus affiliates, 39.94%). Hyundai Motor Group is listed and family-controlled; South Korea's pension fund stake in Hyundai Motor links to no abuse record (no record claim for South Korea).
note: New Jeonbuk Hyundai uniform partner for 2026 (Jeonbuk Ilbo, 2026-02-09); official club sponsor (newspim etc., September 2026 partner-day coverage).
